featured_reviews.name: Tirth Bhayani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being all my life in Mumbai, it was always difficult to find a patisserie, who can provide bakery items that match my taste buds and prices that match my pockets.
Starting with the pros and cons:
Pros:
1) Best cakes, cookies and cupcakes in town. After eating the cookies and cupcakes at La Circle Patisserie, I realized how good a cookie and cupcake can taste, and how other bakeries have led their standards low by providing inadequate taste.
2) Super Fast Delivery. One day I called La Circle Patisserie with an urgent order and I was shocked how they managed to deliver it in just 2 hours while covering a distance of more than 30 kms in a city like Mumbai which is full of traffic.
3) Freshly Baked Products. I have always experienced other bakeries delivering products that are a day old and I am always stunned how La Circle Patisserie sends over freshly baked products and they always customize it as per my requirements.
4) High Quality Standards. I was fortunate enough to visit the patisserie and I realized how clean the bakery was and the kind of raw materials (like sugar, flour ,etc.) that they use are so high quality that sometimes even I won't use them for myself. Thus they have the highest quality standards.
5) Pocket Friendly. The most pocket friendly place I saw in town with such good taste. The sweet owner Nayaja explained me how she focuses on  the taste & quality of products and not high pricing; so that everyone can have the best taste at affordable pricing.
6) Eggless Products. Yes, you heard that right! Being from a pure vegetarian family, this was always my concern and hence this is the perfect destination for satisfying my sweet cravings while following my tradition.

Cons:
The only con is that after eating their products, I don't like anything else in this town; so now all other bakeries are going to get shut with the opening of La Circle Patisserie.

What impressed me most was the variety of options available. Whether you're looking for classic flavors or something more adventurous, Thanksgiving has something for everyone. They also cater to dietary restrictions, offering a range of gluten-free and vegan options that don't compromise on taste.

In addition to cakes, they have a delightful selection of pastries, cookies, and other baked goods, all of which looked equally tempting. I also appreciated the attention to detail in the packaging, making it easy to take home a few extra treats to share.

Overall, Thanksgiving patisserie is a gem for cake lovers and anyone with a sweet tooth. The combination of high-quality ingredients, expert craftsmanship, and exceptional service makes it a must-visit. I can't wait to return and try more of their delicious creations!
